messages:
nina_sales: quick sync AcmeDynamics wants a 3-week POC for SSO+SCIM and strict tenant domain locking. theyre asking about role mapping, SCIM throughput, and audit retention for HIPAA. can we scope?

 tom_se: short: SAML (Okta) supported (IdP & SP flows). SCIM v2 with PATCH/delta supported. Console supports group->role mapping and canary rollouts. domain proofing via TXT + tenant claim verification.

 carmen_infosec: checklist: signed assertions required, Acme needs encrypted assertions. NameID format preference? they asked for persistent ids. audit trail for provisioning + admin actions required for 1yr. we need SP metadata and Okta cert.

 leo_ops: pricing snapshot: Hosted POC fine for validation (est $1k/week baseline). Dedicated trial for predictable latency ~ $3k one-time for 3w reservation. Private = custom for HSM/BAA. Hosted audit logs default 90d; enterprise add-on for 1y.

 nina_sales: @acme_pls can you share expected DAU and provisioning spikes so we can pick Dedicated vs Hosted? also share compliance (HIPAA?)

 deploy-bot: INF-4999 created  reserve Dedicated test node (1x A10g equiv) for acme-poc, 3-week window. assigned eng-runtime.

 tom_se: SCIM guidance: Hosted default 600 reqs/min, Dedicated burst to 1200. recommend PATCH for deltas to reduce payload. sample PATCH:
```
PATCH /Users/ab123
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"emails[type eq \"work\"].value","value":"sam@acmedyn.com"}]
}
```
 carmen_infosec: session timeout: they requested 15m idle. we can set per-tenant on Dedicated/Private. encryption: exchange public keys, we will provide SP cert + metadata.

 nina_sales: Acme replied: DAU ~12k, normal onboard 2k/wk, migration spikes up to 6k/day. HIPAA applies, audit retention 1y, assertion encryption required, will provide Okta export and SP metadata this afternoon.

 leo_ops: actions: 1) acme provide SP metadata + Okta group export + IP allowlist, 2) tom post SCIM throughput config + mapping snippet, 3) carmen to add KMS/BAA notes, 4) infra to confirm INF-4999 schedule. i'll prepare POC estimate (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and MSA excerpt.

 tom_se: RBAC mapping example we'll include: `okta:group=="engineering:admins" -> role:infra_admin` and support canary flag for staged rollout.

 carmen_infosec: note: for HIPAA recommend Dedicated or Private with BAA. Hosted may be ok with add-on & review but flag for legal.

 nina_sales: great, i'll draft SOW and share today. :thumbsup:
